title: Position of Parts of Speech (Ques. No. 201-236)
subtopic: Position of Parts of Speech (236 Marks)

questions.question: The post must be <u>manned</u> immediately.[]
questions.explanation:
manned → Verb
must be manned → কাজ বোঝাচ্ছে
Trick: be + V3 → verb

questions.question: The child sat <u>mute</u> in the corner of the park.[]
questions.explanation:
mute → Adjective
sat mute → child কে describe করছে

questions.question: The flight is leaving <u>shortly</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
shortly → Adverbial
leaving shortly → verb modify করছে

questions.question: His answer was a decided <u>no</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
no → Noun
a decided no → article (a) + adj+ noun

questions.question: Man's intellectual has a natural pride in its <u>own</u> aristocracy.[]
questions.explanation:
intellectual → Adjective
intellectual pride → pride কে describe
-al suffix

questions.question: I have a <u>laptop</u> computer. The underlined word is a/an ---[]
questions.explanation:
laptop → Adjective
laptop computer → noun + noun → প্রথমটা adjective

questions.question: He knows English <u>better</u> than I.[]
questions.explanation:
better → Adverb
knows better → verb modify

questions.question: In my opinion, she should have resigned <u>earlier</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
earlier → Adverb
resigned earlier → verb modify

questions.question: The aircraft has four emergency exists. Here 'exists' is a/an ---[]
questions.explanation:
exits → Noun
four emergency exits → number + noun

questions.question:
The dog was running <u>behind.</u>
The weather was <u>rather</u> worse than I had expected.[]
questions.explanation:
behind / rather → Adverb
running behind → verb modify

questions.question: Babu is <u>meritorious</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
meritorious → Adjective
Babu কে describe
Linking verb(is)+Adjective

questions.question: I accompanied every student 'except' you. []
questions.explanation:
except → Preposition
except you → pronoun এর আগে

questions.question: Let us <u>beautify</u> the room.[]
questions.explanation:
beautify → Verb
কাজ বোঝাচ্ছে
-fy suffix

questions.question: We go to our university by our <u>university</u> bus. The underlined word is a/an ---[]
questions.explanation:
university → Adjective
university bus → bus কে describe

questions.question: He is <u>not</u> enjoying this activity.[]
questions.explanation:
not → Adverb
not enjoying → verb modify

questions.question: Kuakata is a sanctuary of <u>migratory</u> birds.[]
questions.explanation:
migratory → Adjective
migratory birds → birds(n) কে describe

questions.question: May you live <u>long</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
long → Adverb
live long → verb modify

questions.question: How <u>long</u> will it take to get there ? The underlined word is ---[]
questions.explanation:
how long → Adverb
time/degree বোঝাচ্ছে

questions.question: The student speaks <u>softly</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
softly → Adverb
speaks softly → verb modify
-ly suffix

questions.question: Please, come again. Here 'please' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
please → Adverb
request modify করছে

questions.question:
I <u>quite</u> agree with you.
I <u>usually</u> study in the library.[]
questions.explanation:
quite / usually → Adverb
verb modify

questions.question: Rahim came <u>later</u> than Karim. The underlined word is ---[]
questions.explanation:
later → Adverb
came later
Verb+Adv

questions.question: It seems to me that I have seen him <u>before.</u>[]
questions.explanation:
before → Adverb
time বোঝাচ্ছে

questions.question: Please do not look <u>back</u>.[]
questions.explanation:
back → Adverb
look back → direction
Verb এরপরে adverb হয়

questions.question: My father is an English teacher. Here 'English' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
English → Adjective
English teacher
Adj+noun

questions.question: Don't aim <u>too</u> high.[]
questions.explanation:
too high → Adverb
aim  → verb modify
V+Adv+adj(basic structure)

questions.question: The meeting came to a close. Here the word 'close' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
close → Noun
a close → article + noun

questions.question:
He is very <u>dangerous</u>.
His treatment was <u>friendly.</u>[]
questions.explanation:
dangerous / friendly → Adjective
noun describe

questions.question: The girl in <u>blue</u> is cooking.[]
questions.explanation: preposition (in) +noun(blue)

questions.question: He drives zigzag on the way. Here 'zigzag' is ---[]
questions.explanation:
zigzag → Adverb
drives zigzag
V+Adv

questions.question: I do not have <u>much</u> money to purchase a car.[]
questions.explanation:
much → Adjective
much money → money describe

questions.question: Emily has to clean her  <u>messy</u> room before she goes out.[]
questions.explanation:
messy → Adjective
messy room
Adj+n

questions.question:
He is <u>behind</u> you.
He is <u>beside</u> me.[]
questions.explanation:
behind / beside → Preposition
noun/pronoun এর আগে

questions.question: You will not achieve your aim <u>unless</u> you work hard for it.[]
questions.explanation:
unless → Conjunction
clause join

questions.question:
My father is an <u>English</u> teacher.
The <u>college</u> teacher is popular among his students.[]
questions.explanation:
college → Adjective
college teacher
N+N থাকলে শুরুটা adj হয়

questions.question: Wait here <u>until</u> I return. Here the underlined word is -----.[]
questions.explanation:
until → Conjunction
until I return → clause introduce
